candidate_executor: reviewed source commit and binary SHA-256 pinned in executor.json and each predeclared.json before live work
comparison: same new prompt and unchanged tests/reference; treatment bundles runtime, role allocation and transport accounting; not a prompt-invariant comparison with prior variants
no_retries: One attempt per declared cell; interruptions remain negative evidence, no in-place rerun or replacement. Preflight failure stops before calls.
qualification: All original native completion, authored acceptance, fresh exact native proof, both-role, scope, protected-file, process, build, 864-original-test minimum, visible regression, six-probe oracle, replay, receipt and secrecy gates remain required. Blocked never qualifies.
measurement: Separate six development milestones with observed/not_observed/not_evaluated and first unmet stage. No weighted pass score and no qualification override.
oracle_policy: Visible fixture, six-probe independent oracle and reference content byte-identical to recovery-handoff-visible. Task prompt and budgets are separate frozen inputs.
